events.title: Proposed ruling: refund_full $5.00 (model confidence 0.92)
events.body: The rider booked a 09:52 pickup and cancelled at 10:00:00, 8 minutes after the scheduled time [F4][F2]. The driver never came within 200 m of the pickup point — closest approach 4069 m at 10:00:00 [F1] — and the platform never recorded an arrival: driver_arrived_at is null and no "I'm Here" tap or automatic arrival exists [F5][F6]. The driver sent 0 in-app messages and made 0 in-app calls before the cancellation [F3]. The rider's messages show she waited and chased — "where are you? It's already the pickup time" at 09:52 [F9], then "Still no car. I'm cancelling" at 09:59 [F10] — a complete, fully timestamped chat record [F11]. Under NS-8, a driver not at the pickup by scheduled time + 5 minutes gives the rider a free cancellation, and a fee charged is refunded in full; the rider cancelled 8 minutes after the scheduled time [F4][F2][NS-8]. NS-8 also requires a $5.00 goodwill credit where the driver made no contact attempt, which the trace confirms from the zero messages and calls [F3][NS-8]. Because the driver never arrived and the platform has no arrival record, the NS-1 no-show preconditions cannot hold: there was no arrival confirmation with GPS within 200 m [F1][F5][F6], and no chat message or call before cancelling [F3][NS-1]. The driver's post-hoc statement that traffic was heavy [F12] does not change the outcome: a no-show fee under NS-1 turns on arrival, wait and contact, not on the driver's difficulty reaching the pickup, and NS-2 voids the fee where any NS-1 condition fails. No NS-2 account flag is ordered because the driver did not mark arrival while away from the pickup — he never marked arrival at all [F6]. The profile facts (rider clean [F16]; driver with 2 upheld no-show matters in 90 days [F17]) do not decide this case. Amount: the cancellation fee charged on record is $5.00 [F7][NS-8], refunded in full, giving amount = $5.00.
